prompts.boar: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite animation sheet for this existing Asterix-inspired game. Match the provided Roman reference's hand-inked Franco-Belgian cartoon look: confident dark outlines, expressive anatomy, warm flat cel colors with restrained shaded volumes. NOT pixel art, NOT 3D, NOT realistic. Make exactly 12 isolated full-body poses in a strict 4 columns by 3 rows rectangular grid, each cell equal sized, substantial transparent gutters and padding. All face RIGHT in the same side/three-quarter view. Same character design and fixed body scale in every frame, feet on the same baseline within each row. Entire subject fits inside its own cell, no overlap, nothing clipped. True transparent alpha everywhere outside characters, no ground, no shadows, no background texture, no checkerboard, NO text, numbers, labels or grid lines. Row 1 four distinct cyclic walk/run poses; row 2 four action phases anticipation, windup, impact, recovery; row 3 four non-gory hit-reaction phases. Each row must contain precisely four poses. Reference is style and proportions only, do not duplicate the reference sheet contents. Subject: one stout wild boar from the Gallic forest, bristly dark brown back, large expressive eyes, pale curved tusks, broad snout, small hooves. Comical but fierce, low horizontal body. Row 1 bounding four-beat run with alternating hooves. Row 2 lowers head, paws ground, lunges tusks forward, lifts head. Row 3 recoils, scrunches snout, staggers, recovers. No clothing or human rider.
